senses.gloss:
पूगः [पू-गन् किच्च्; Uṇ. 1. 121]
1
{1} A multitude, heap, collection,
quantity; Śi. 9. 64.
--2 An
association, corporation, union; Y. 2. 30;
Ms. 3. 151.
--3 The areca or
betelnut-tree (पूगी also); R. 4. 44;
6. 64; 13. 17.
--4 Nature, property,
disposition.
--गं Areca-nut,
betelnut.
--Comp.
--कृत a. heaped,
collected.
--पात्रं {1} a spitting-pot,
spittoon. {2} a betel-box.
--पीठः-ठं
a spitting-pot.
--पुष्पिका betel-nut
and flowers given to guests at a
marriage ceremony.
--फलं the
areeanut.
--वैरं enmity against many
men.
